title: Signal and Protocol
author: O. M. Galloway
blurb: Tamsin Marchetti, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
